apps.title: Stable.com
apps.description:
Stable.com simplifies your financial management with a global multi-payment application.

Tailored for the diverse needs of startups, scale-ups, enterprises, individuals, and freelancers, Stable.com transforms financial management. Experience a seamless blend of multi-currency accounts, cards, and FX & transfer functionalities, delivering a comprehensive financial solution.

Dynamic features for every need:

Global Accounts: Universal payments in multiple currencies. Our multicurrency corporate account supports transactions in major currencies like EUR, USD, GBP, and CNY making it perfect for global coverage. The Stable.com multicurrency account allows seamless transactions worldwide and is compatible with digital wallets like Google Pay and Apple Pay.

Get paid like a local: Get paid in the currency you want and pay your suppliers or contractors in their preferred currency, from EUR and USD to CNY or MXN.

Online KYB: Sign up for an account completely digitally.

Comprehensive Corporate and Business Accounts: Empower your organization with our robust corporate and business account services, ensuring financial agility and control.

Unhindered currency operations through FX, and transfers: Stable.com empowers businesses with seamless FX (foreign exchange) transactions, allowing for quick and efficient currency conversions at competitive rates.

The business account for going global: Pay invoices and bills faster, at a better exchange rate. Offer your customers a wide array of payment options to streamline checkout processes. This includes all major card brands and many currencies including USD, EUR, BRL, MXN, etc. Connect to supported platforms like Amazon, eBay, Google and Apple Pay and pay for ad services on AdSense, Meta and many more.
- Multi-Currency IBAN Accounts: Open numerous accounts to streamline your business transactions.
- Global Wire Transfers: Effortlessly conduct international transactions using SWIFT and SEPA.
- Worldwide Payment Receptions: Receive payments from any corner of the globe, in the currency you want.
- Currency Exchange: Seamlessly exchange major world currencies.
- Cross-Platform Accessibility: Manage your finances on desktop or mobile, anytime, anywhere.
- Virtual and Physical Cards: Issue cards for your team and manage expenses effortlessly.
- Smart Financial Management: Utilize our smart filter and transaction search for real-time expense tracking.
- Comprehensive Notifications: Get instant alerts for all transaction types.
- Multiple Account Management: Handle various accounts simultaneously with ease.
- Universal Payment Options: Enjoy the freedom to pay online and offline, globally.
- Security You Can Trust:
- Two-Factor Authentication (2FA): Secure your web app access on a PC or laptop.
- Biometric Security: Leverage FaceID or TouchID for enhanced protection.
- Reliable and Safe: Your financial security is our top priority.

What's New:
- Card Top-Up: Reload your card with ease.
- Expanded currency support, including stablecoin transactions.
- Online Onboarding: Enjoy a seamless self-service questionnaire and automated account opening.
- Revamped App Design: Experience our updated, user-friendly interface.

apps.title: Stable Payments
apps.description: Manage all of your expenses and payments while on the move and travelling for business with Stable Payments. Access your expense card details, add it to your device wallet and capture receipts at the point of purchase. Tag and annotate transactions and request card balance top ups from within the app. Users that have already signed up with Stable Payments can login, manage their account and access their transactions, all within the app.

apps.title: Ramp
apps.description:
Ramp is the finance automation platform designed to save you time and money. With Ramp you get corporate cards, expense management, bill payments, accounting automation and reporting—all in one easy-to-use solution.


Ramp Mobile puts finance automation in your pocket. Pay for expenses quickly with your corporate card at your fingertips. Submit expense reports and reimbursements on the go by taking a picture of your receipt and tapping in a memo or other submission requirements. Plus, with simplified visibility, you’ll always have the information you need on expense policies, recent transactions, or spend requests.


App Features:


- View & lock your cards

- Add card to Google Pay

- Request new spend or temporary spend increase

- Take a picture of your receipt and auto-match to transaction

- Submit additional requirements like memos & accounting fields

- Request reimbursements

- View all transactions & spend requests

- See your expense policy

- Set communication preferences

- Dark/light themes

apps.title: iTeller: Global Payouts
apps.summary: Virtual cards, digital wallet, fiat payouts and money transfers
apps.description:
iTeller is a digital finance platform for verified users, offering digital wallet access, virtual cards, fiat payout, and money transfer services.

With iTeller, users can manage balances, access virtual card services where available, and request payouts through supported payment rails.

Key features:

• Digital wallet access
• Virtual card services where available
• Fiat payouts and money transfer services
• On-ramp and off-ramp support
• Secure account access and verification
• Simple dashboard to manage balances and transactions

iTeller is designed for individuals and businesses who need a simple way to access card services, manage funds, and move money globally.

All services are subject to account verification, compliance checks, supported countries, transaction limits, and service availability. iTeller does not provide loans, payday loans, buy now pay later, credit facilities, or investment advice.
